effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

transitions.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster with a DEF 2000 or less from the Deck to the field. Then shuffle the Deck.
transitions.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the battle-destruction trigger resolves with no Zombie-Type monster of 2000 or less DEF in the Deck, the goat script reveals the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script has no reveal branch. The printed text is untouched by this in every lineage version.

transitions.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster with a DEF 2000 or less from the Deck to the field. Then shuffle the Deck.
transitions.summary: Separate per-card era allowance: the goat target is `if chk==0 then return true and Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0 end` where the modern target requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,e,tp)` in place of that literal true, so the period implementation lets the trigger activate and resolve with no eligible Zombie in the Deck. No source in the packet dates when this card lost that allowance.

review.notes: Baseline is lineage v1 (SD2-EN005, Structure Deck: Zombie Madness, 2005-01-01); the earlier v0 (PGD-026, 2003-07-18) 'may select ... in face up Attack or Defense Position (no Tribute is required for monsters of Level 5 or more)' predates the baseline and resolves the same way. v1 through v4 (SR07-EN015, 2018-11-01) is cosmetic: 'sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle' -> 'destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard' (v2, CP02-EN004, 2007-02-06), PSCT colon (v3, GLD5-EN003, 2012-06-07), Zombie-Type -> Zombie and Graveyard -> GY (v4). Intermediate-state reasoning as for the other GoatConfirm searchers: the two ruling transitions cannot be ordered against each other, no upstream implementation covers the state between them, and none is attached because GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede the search-verification interval's lower bound of 2011-02-02; if this card's activation allowance had already ended by 2010-04-24 the Edison implementation would need the modern activation check with the era reveal, which upstream does not ship.
